areas/cafe -> surfaces/portal.fix: Move the chat read model types to @purin-labs/control-api/portal/chat. Then give the board a chat port that portal.tsx registers.

areas/integrations -> areas/commerce.fix: The Portal wiring gives the Stripe setup part to the integrations page through the settings transport (features/integrations/settings-transport.ts).

foundation/conversation -> areas/kitchen.reason: The chat record (chat/conversation.ts, chat/timeline.ts) parses and stores the Kitchen surface attachment of a message (BakerySurfaceAttachmentV1), also the form of a tab that loaded the Portal before Plan 87 phase 2.
foundation/conversation -> areas/kitchen.fix: The surface registry of Plan 87: the record keeps an opaque surface state, and the Kitchen registers its state check. The Plan 93 cutover can drop the old tab form.

foundation/conversation -> surfaces/port.fix: The surface registry of Plan 87, as for the Kitchen pair: the Portal registers the adapter, and the record calls it through the registry.
